tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī badz+ra ma hā kā la pañdza ra nā thā ya/ mchog gi dngos grub myur stsol zhing / /phyi nang dgra bgegs kun 'joms pa'i/ /nag po che la rab btud nas/ /drag po'i man ngag bri bar bya/ /'dir rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la dpal gur gyi mgon po'i bka' babs rnam pa bzhi byung ba las/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag mal lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa la/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor gsum las/ dang po gnyis tshul bzhin nyams su blang ba'i gang zag gis dgra bgegs tshar bcad pa'i las la/ shin tu zab pa'i shog ril drug gi nang tshan/ gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag lag tu blang ba'i tshul mtha' yas kyang / 'dir drug cu pa'i tshul/ yi ge rnying pa rnams las gsal bar mi 'byung bas/ blo dman pa rnams kyi don du/ lag len gyi khrigs chags bstan na/ sbyor ba mchod gtor bsham pa/ dngos gzhi bdag bskyed mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i tshul/ rjes bskul dang gtor ma 'phangs pa'i tshul bstan pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar 'os pa'i sa phyogs su thig chen brgyad btab la/ chos 'byung nag po me ris dang bcas pa'i nang du/ 'khor lo rtsibs drug sngon po'i lte ba dang / rtsibs rnams la lha brgyad kyi tshom bu chos 'byung gi zur du bran bdud kyi tshom bu bkod/ bkod pa'i khar man dzi'i steng du/ lcags kyi snod che bar zan leb gru gsum che chung gsum brtsegs kyi steng du/ gtor ma gru gsum che ba gcig bzhag /'og gi bang rim rnams la/ bshos bu gru gsum chung ba drug cu rtsa gsum lag len ltar bkod/ bang rim 'og ma la phyogs rer bcu gnyis te sum cu so drug bang rim bar ma la phyogs rer brgyad brgyad de nyi shu rtsa bzhi/

bang rim steng ma'i zur rnams su re re ste gsum bzhag bran bdud ma gtogs gzhan thams cad khrag gis byug go gtor ma zur gsum gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i dpal 'bar btsugs pa bzhag lho phyogs kyi chos 'byung gi rtse mor pu tra'i gtor ma zur gsum dang / bran bdud yab yum gyi bshos bu nag po che chung gnyis snod gcig tu bshams/ de dag gi mtha' skor du/ khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog sogs drag po'i mchod pa g.yon skor du bkod/ de'i byang du gtor thebs lnga tshar gnyis/ mtheb skyu dang / ling ga shong pa'i snod bya/ snod che ba gnyis kyi nang du mtheb skyu drug cu rtsa bzhi sha dmar pos brgyan pa dang / ling ga chung ba drug cu rtsa bzhi bcos la/ dbugs dang grib ma ma shor ba bya/ gtor ma sbyong ba'i khrag dang / chang phud kyang g.yas g.yon du bshams/ mthar sham chu gtong ba'i snod ji ltar rigs pa chu gtsang dang bcas pa/ gzhan stegs ji ltar 'os pa la yi dam chos skyong gi mchod gtor gang dgos dang thun gtor zur gsum bzhi yang bshams/ slob dpon kha lhor bstan pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu ḍa ma ru nang mchod rnams dang / gri lcags kyi gri gug dar nag btags pa/ gzhan yang rnga/ sil snyan/ dung / gu gul/ gser skyems sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par 'du byas la/ rnal 'byor pa rnams gral la 'khod nas/ zlum gtor gtor ma chung ngu gcig logs su chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsar+b+ba thā khaṃ/ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa/ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba l+ya de swā hā/ lan gsum brjod la/ gang zhig 'byung po 'das dang ma byon gyi gdang mdzad/ mthu chen dang / /sems can la 'tshe bstan la gnod/ /sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje che/

/bgegs kyi steng na mthu stobs mchog /gal te bka' las 'da' byed na/ rdo rje 'bar bas 'joms par byed/ /de bas sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /dang ba'i tshul gyis rab khyer la/ /rol mo bdun brdungs gsum/ ci bde bar ni gzhan du dengs/ /sha sa na brjod ci nga rol mo chems brdung mdzad/ sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ de nas mdun gyi mchod pa rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'di nyid drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i phyi nang gi dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ dung chen gyi gling bu sogs/ rol mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ ā ཿhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū paṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo kaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai be d+yaṃ ā ཿhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ rol mo dkrol/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni pradzña pā ra mi tā nā da swa bhā we na badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya ni san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ phyag len la lam dus mdzad/ mi shes na mgon po'i bsrung 'khor rkyang pas kyang rung / rgyas par na kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bya/

bsdus na mgon po'i bsrung 'khor bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa ltar bsgom la/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang bdun ma ji ltar rigs pa dang sha sa na brgya rtsa gcig bzlas pa'i mthar/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ su gang bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa sogs nas/ de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig /ma hā kā la'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po yi/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig sbyor ba yis/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum bsrungs/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor rnams rang gi snying khar thim/ de nas logs su bshams pa'i yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma rnams/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ gtor ma byin rlabs kye rdor ltar byas nas/ kye rdor/ bde mchog sogs la/ cho ga ltar gtor ma phul te/ mgon po'i gtor mgron bskyed pa'i skabs su/ mdun gyi chos 'byung 'khor lo dang bcas pa la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du saṃ las rdo rje'i brag rdzong zur gsum pa stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag me 'bar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ brag ri dmar nag gis bskor ba'i dbus me rlung tshub pa'i steng du/ gnam lcags las grub pa'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar/ paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/

tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po che zhing cher 'bar ba nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang po'i steng du/ traṃ las e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba khro mo'i rnam pa can/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du traka las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo nas/ hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrogs pa/ rtsibs gnyis par yaḥlas nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon zhing / gser gyi rna cha can/ rtsibs gsum par maṃḥlas nag mo gnod sbyin sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon klad khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ rtsibs bzhi par triḥlas pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar gyi aṅga rag dang / dar nag gi na bza' can/ rtsibs lnga par triḥlas bha ṭa nag po stag slog can/ g.yas dam shing dang / g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ rtsibs drug par bh+yoḥlas sring mo ral gcig ma g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon rgyu ma 'dzin zhing kha nas me 'bar ba/ lnga ka'ang / sku mdog mthing nag rab tu 'phros pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dgra bgegs kyi rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rngams shing 'khrugs pas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas thogs pa brgya/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/

slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba ban+de nag po phur thogs brgya/ mdun gyi shul byang 'dren pa bud med kyi tshul can brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod par byed pa'i bya nag khyi nag lce spyang / mi nag la sogs pa/ las kyi mgon po la bka' stod pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs dang / thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo dang / las kyi mgon po la bka' stod pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po kun gshegs༞ lha mo kun gshegs༞ las mgon kun gshegs sogs spyan 'dren/ mchod pa dam bzhag gtor ma phul nas phyi nang gi mchod pa/ 'phrin las 'chol ba rnams gtor chog dkyus bzhin/ de nas mgon po gdong bzhi pa dang / las mgon rnams la gtor ma phul rjes/ bran sdud kyi gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ chos 'byung gi lho zur bskal pa'i me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ rta bra nag rus pa'i rgyan cha can/ dug sbrul nag pos gong rmed byas shing / mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi bkab pa'i steng du yaḥnag po las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bran sdud gshin rje nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum dang ldan pas/ phyag g.yas kyi ru mtshon la gzigs pa/ dar nag po gser gyi thig le can gyi 'jol ber gsol ba la/ sbrul gyi ska rags can/ bdud kyi khraṃ shing sked par btsugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa ru mtshon rtse gsum pa la mi mgo rlon pa bzhi 'phyang ba dang bcas pa 'dzin zhing / g.yon pas mi rnying rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa la dug sbrul nag po gnyis kyi snying rtsa'i khrag 'jib pa thogs pa/ zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ mched mo spu gri ma thal kya kha nas me 'bar zhing / lag pa gnyis gyen du gdengs pas/

me dpung 'bar ba re re thogs pa/ tsog pu'i 'dug stangs kyis gtso bo la gzigs pa/ gcer mo rgyan med cing skra grol ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ra hūm̐/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas/ yab yum la 'khor sde brgyad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ gnyi ka'i spyi bor rdo rje sngon po phyed pa res rgyas btab pa/ oṃ ma hā kā la yak+ṣa muts+tsha kro dha ya ma rā dza ma ri ma sha/ muts+tsha ya bh+yoḥ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trun bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi phyi mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mjug tu 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ hūm̐ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i pha rol na/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ /gshin rje nag po phyag gnyis pa/ /mtshon chas dgra bgegs sgrol la bstod/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /de nas dkar bdud dam can/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ de ba pi tsu ci rigs pas 'go drangs nas/ mgon po rnams kyi sngags ci nus pa bzla/ bshags pa byas nas/ bskang rdzas kyi gtor ma dang / mchod rdzas rnams a mṛ tas bsang / swa shā was sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'di nyid mi mgo'i ra ba gru bzhir brtsegs pa'i thod pa mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang bse smug po'i sgo can steng du zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ rus pa'i phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i nang du a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs par phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs rnams bkug cing bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag rus gsum gyi gtor ma ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa/ khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog

tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgron me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ dung chen gyi gling bu sogs/ rol mo'i bye brag bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang / gzhan yang hūm̐ las byung ba'i rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag bya nag mi nag la sogs pa skye 'gro'i tshogs dang / stag gzig go khrab/ gos dar/ mtshon cha la sogs pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa dang / rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa la sogs pa/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ s+pha ra na khaṃ swā hā/ de nas rol mo dkrol zhing spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /sogs dang / chos dbyings spros bral mdzad/ sngon tshe rgyal ba sogs dang / lha mchog ma hā kā la sogs kyi spyan 'dren rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bskang gtor rnams bsngo/ de nas ling ga dang / mtheb skyu rnams gu gul gyis bdug cing / slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ dzaḥn mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje la sogs pa'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ yum chen sring mo bzhi sogs/ rdo rje'i chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi༞ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing / chos can las 'bras slu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang / khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad skad cig nyid la gzugs dang ling ga 'di la mchis par gyur cig

/oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sarba sha trūn bigh+nān ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya mā ra ya hūm̐/ zhes pa'i dgug gzhug lan gsum dang / log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad ces pa yan gong bzhin la/ skyob par byed pa'i lha dang / 'go ba'i lha dang / srung bar byed pa'i lha thams cad dang phrol cig oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya sarba sha trūn bigh+nān/ sarba de wa rak+ṣa bi de sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥngs ni ma nyes ma thob bo/ /zhes pa'i dpang gzugs bram ze nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa 'dir mdzad/ de nas 'das dang ma byon no/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'dril bar gdon sdigs/ /g.yas pas gri gug dgra srog gcod/ /g.yon pas gdug pa'i khrag rkang gsol/ /zhabs brdab gnod sems can lus nyed/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum gnod dang / bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /bdag gi bsgo ba kun khug la/ /ling ga 'di la myur du chug /'di yi sha zo khrag la 'thung / /rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo/ /rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod las shog /'dza' ba kun dang khrol las shog /bdag gi bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ rol mo bdun brdung gsum/ /dpal ldan mgon po nag po khyod/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /sogs nas/ tshig 'di snon bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ rol mo dgu brdung gcig gi mthar chems brdung ngo / /ces pa'i bar brjod cing / rol mo drag tu brdung / shā sa na brjod cing / ling ga gri gug gis dum bur bsgral la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i tshig gis bstab/ de rjes byang gi gtor thebs tshar gcig tu ling ga dang / mtheb kyu sha dang bcas pa bcug la/ khrag dang chang gis sbyangs/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥlan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ shā sa na tshar lnga dang / lha mo la kā li de wi dang / zhal bzhi pa'i gtor sngags ring thung gang rung dang / las mgon la a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥsogs/ bran bdud kyi gtor sngags rnams tshar re brjod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhe/ nai bi d+ye/ shap+ta pra tits+tshā swā hā/ de nas nang mchod phul la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi/ bran bdud gshin rje nag po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzad 'di la rol mo chems brdung bya/ du gsol/ 'di'i bar la mchod g.yog pa gnyis kyis ling ga dang mtheb kyu sngar bsham pa rnams/ dbus kyi gtor ma che ba'i mtha' skor du blug slar yang gong bzhin bshams/ khrag dang chang gi sbyang ba sogs nas/ 'phrin las 'chol ba'i bar tshar bcu gsum byas pa'i tha ma la/ gtor thebs gnyis su bshal chu blug la phul rjes gtor thebs rnams bshal la/ khrag gi rjes med par bya/ de nas rgyas par na bdud rtsi lnga mchod bya zhing / bsdu na mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ bdag gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /sogs nas/ gnod pa'i bgegs la las mdzod cig /'dod pa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar dang / de nas lha mo'i bskang gso rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/ zhal bzhi pa'i bskang gso byas rjes/ nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /zhes pa nas/ rkyen ngan rbod gtong med par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar dang / dpal ldan mgon po dgongs su gsol/

/nas/ sgrub cing rtag tu khyod mchod do/ /zhes pa'i bar bya/ de nas mgon po rnams kyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs par byas la/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sogs dang / rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ smon lam/ de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /gi bar dang / phyag len dkyus ma la mi mdzad/ tshogs 'khor yod na skabs 'dir byas la/ lhag ma gtang ngo / /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ rnal 'byor pa rnams langs la/ rnga brdung zhing / kye bos so nas/ mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /kyi bar dang / dpal ldan chos skyong mgon po khyod/ /sogs bka' bsgos nas gtor ma rnams btegs la/ phyi rol ji ltar 'os pa'i sar gong gi thun gtor rnams chang phud dang bcas pa khyer nas/ bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i pu tra'i bskang gso'i mjug bzhin mdzad/ mon bu pu tra gnas nas bskyod/ /sogs kyis las mgon bskul/ spyi bstab kyi thun gtor phul la/ gson dang mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /sogs dang lha chen dpal 'bar sogs kyi bzlog pa bya/ bh+yoḥgason cig 'dod khams gtso mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /sogs/ lha mo'i bzlog pa bdag chen blo gros pas mdzad pa dang / hūm̐ chos skyong stobs 'phrog nag po da tshur gson/ sogs zhal dang / dam can mon bu pu tra khyod/ /sogs pu tra'i bskul gnyis/ bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa rnams phyag len la/ skabs 'dir mdzad/ de nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma sogs kyi bskul byed cing / zor gtor rnams 'gro phyogs su/ sngon la bran bdud/ de nas pu tra'i gtor ma dang / zor che ba rnams rim pas khyer la/ gtor ma brdeg sar sleb pa dang / gser skyems btang ba ni/ dpal ldan rtsa rgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi tshogs/ /khyad par thabs shes gnyis med pa'i/ /kye yi rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/

/mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes phrin las kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pa drag po'i sku/ /rdo rje gur gyi mgon po dang / /dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /bdud rtsi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhing skyong dbang phyug zhal bzhi pa/ /lcam dral dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum dang / sha za 'bum sde 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdud rtsi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /bka' nyan gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /khams gsum srog gi gshed ma ni/ /las mkhan mon bu pu tra dang / bha ṭa gser gi gri gug ma/ /bdud rtsi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /nag po stong dang nag mo 'bum/ /ma mo bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /phyogs kyi ru 'dren sde bzhi sogs/ /drag po'i 'khor tshogs thams cad kyang / /bdud rtsi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang gza' chen brgyad/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /rgyal chen bzhi dang 'jigs byed dgu /bdud rtsi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang / /yul phyogs 'di yi gnas bdag dang / /gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag dang / /bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ /bdud rtsi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/

/mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang / /bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /gzhan yang dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /phrin las sgrub la bar gcod pa/ /gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad kyang / /gser skyems 'di yis tshim byas nas/ /rnal 'byor bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gats+tsha/ dpal 'bar ma hā kā la dang / /lha chen dpal 'bar mthu chen gyi/ /steng nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /sogs kyi bskul la/ gtor ma rnams rim pas 'phang zhing / phod ka'am/ chos gos kyis g.yab mo brdab/ dmod bcol drag tu byas la/ phyi mig mi lta bar nang du log nas/ sgrub gtor rnams khang thog la sogs par/ gtang rag gi tshul du phul la/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor dang / yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / mdun gyi chos 'byung du bskyed pa'i lha rnams/ ras bris yod na de la bstim/ med na bdag la bsdu/ gzhan gshegs gsol/ brtan bzhugs skabs dang sbyar la/ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag po'i sku/ /hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro 'brug stong 'dir ba'i gsung / /spros pa nyer zhi mkha' dbyings chen po'i thugs/ /dpal mgon ma hā kā la'i bkra shis shog /gang gi mthu yi brgya byin wa ltar zhum/ /ming tsam thos pas nad do cog las skyob/ /mtshan tsam khams gsum myul ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /ma gcig srid gsum bdag mo'i bkra shis shog /dpa' brjid mi sdug mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal/ /ral pa dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /ljags kyi dbang po glog ltar 'khyug pa can/ /zhing skyong gdong pa bzhi yi bkra shis shog /sprul pa bye bas sa gsum khyab par 'gengs/ /bdud dpung tshar gcod sgrub la dngos grub stsol/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa/ /pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zhes sogs bkra shis dang / rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /shin tu gsang ba'i man ngag ni/ gab cing 'khrugs par bzhugs na yang /

/'khrul med dam pa'i rjes 'brangs te/ /blo dman don phyir gsal bar bris/ /phyin chad lag tu len 'dod rnams/ /dgra bgegs gnad gcod spu gri 'dis/ /phyi nang gnod pa'i tshogs bcom nas/ /zung 'jug ye shes sku thob shog /ces pa dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs/ gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri zhes bya ba/ shrī sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong rig sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ pār+thi baḥces pa sa skyong gi lo/ shra ba ṇā ces pa gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can la shrī nā len+d+ra'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zla ba grags kyis bgyis pa'o/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod par gyur cig/ //maṃ ga laṃ// //e waṃ// // ༄༅/ /mchan 'di rnams/ rje bla ma de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis bris pa lags/ gtor bzlog gi phyag phyi mang du byas pas yid ches yod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs sogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
